TITLE: Israel, Hezbollah war persists despite truce extension; Lebanon's death toll nears 3,000
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-18 13:22 (updated 13:28)
AUTHORS: Laila Bassam (Beirut), Alexander Cornwell (Jerusalem), Eman Abouhassira (Dubai)
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY FACTS:
- Israel airstrikes in southern Lebanon Monday
- 45-day ceasefire extension began at midnight (after Friday's US-brokered talks)
- Lebanese NNA: Israeli airstrikes on 6+ locations in south Lebanon
- IDF: struck 30+ Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon previous 24 hours
- Warned residents of 3 villages in south to leave

OVERNIGHT STRIKE — BAALBECK:
- Killed Palestinian Islamic Jihad commander Wael Mahmoud Abd al-Halim
- His daughter also killed (per Lebanese security sources; IDF made no mention of daughter)
- IDF said had taken steps to "mitigate the risk of harm to civilians"

HEZBOLLAH ATTACKS:
- Launched explosive drone at Iron Dome air defence position in Galilee
- Other attacks on Israeli forces in Lebanon
- IDF: "launches" + explosive drone crossed into Israeli territory

DEATH TOLL:
- Lebanon health ministry (Sunday): 2,988 dead since war erupted March 2; 613 women, children and healthcare workers among
- Israel: 18 soldiers + 1 defence ministry contractor killed
- Hezbollah attacks: 2 Israeli civilians killed in north
- Hezbollah fighter deaths not in MoH toll; Reuters previously reported several thousand fighters killed

CONTEXT:
- Iran has said ending Israel's war in Lebanon is one of its demands for wider deal
- Hezbollah objects to Beirut's talks with Israel
- Israeli forces occupy self-declared security zone in south, razing villages
- US-led mediation parallel to US-Iran diplomacy
